name: AccommodationsReviewOutput
description: AccommodationsReviewOutput schema from Booking.com Demand API

date.description: The date when the review was last modified. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

language.description: An IETF language tag code that uniquely identifies a supported human language or dialect as described here: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/IETF_language_tag. Note that in v3 the whole tag is always lowercase. Examples: "nl" for Dutch/Nederlands or "en-us" for English (US). To retrieve the full list of supported languages, call the `/common/languages` endpoint in the same Demand API version you are using.

country.description: A two-letter code that uniquely identifies a country. This code is defined by the ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 standard (ISO2) as described here: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-1_alpha-2. The full list can be obtained by calling common/locations/countries.

name.description: Name of the reviewer. If the value is null then the reviewer is anonymous.

travel_purpose.description: Defines if this was a leisure or business trip.

score.description: The aggregated score of the review.

text_meets_guidelines.description: Set to true when review meets the guidelines. The review text will be removed if it doesn't meet guidelines.
